FULL TEXT:
OFFICE
OF
THE DISTRICT EDUCATIONAL OFFICER, JANGAON DISTRICT
Date: 02.11.2026
Applications Invited for Engagement
of
External Part-Time Guest Faculty for
HT-JEE & NEET Coaching at TGMS, Kodakandla.
Applications are invited from eligible and experienced candidates for engagement
of
Six (06) External Part-Time Guest Faculty at Telangana Model School (TOMS),
Kodakandla, Jangaon District, to provide IIT-JEE and NEET coaching to Intermediate First
and Second Year students durinb the Academic Year 2026-27 in the following subjects:
SI. No. Subject No.
of
Faculty
1 Mathematics - A & B 2
2 Physics 1
3 Chemistry 1
4 Botany 1
5 Zoology 1
Total 6
Educational Qualifications: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant
subject from a recognised University, namely M.Sc. Mathematics, M.Sc. Physics, M.Sc.
Chemistry, M.Sc. Botany or M.Sc. Zoology, as applicable.
Experience: A minimum
of
three (03) years
of
teaching experience in IIT-JEE/NEET
coaching or foundation courses is mandatory.
Candidates must possess sound subject knowledge, good English communication
skills, proficiency in JCT-enabled teaching and smart classroom tools, good moral character
and medical fitness.
Preference: Preference will be given to candidates qualified in JEE/GATE/NET or
equivalent examinations, candidates having experience in reputed coaching institutions or
Government Residential Excellence Institutions, and those having a proven track record
of
producing successful results in competitive examinations.
Remuneration: Rs.650/- per hour for the actual hours
of
work rendered, subject to
applicable guidelines and availability
of
funds.
Selection: Selection will
be
based on verification
of
educational qualifications and teaching
experience, subject competency and performance in demonstration classes and interviews.
Submission
of
Applications: Interested candidates shall submit their applications along with
bio-data, copies
of
educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and other
relevant documents at either
of
the following offices:
I. Office
of
the District Educational Officer, Jangaon, F-27, First Floor, Jangaon.
2. Office
of
the Principal, Telangana Model School, Kodakandla, Jangaon District.
Applications will be received from 03.11.2026 to 06.11.2026.
The engagement is purely temporary and on a part-time hourly basis for the Academic
Year 2026-27 and shall not confer any right to regular appointment. The date and venue
of
•
demonstration classes/interviews will be communicated to eligible candidates separately.
Sd/- Sandeep Kumar Jha, I.A.S
District Educational Officer,Jangaon district
